facts.text: The hotel is on St. Stephen's Green at the beginning of Grafton Street, Dublin's main shopping avenue.
facts.excerpt: We’re right at the beginning of Grafton Street, the city’s main shopping avenue, on St. Stephen’s Green, the main square.

facts.text: The Luas tram stops right outside the hotel's front door, reaching Trinity College and the Book of Kells in about two minutes.
facts.excerpt: Right outside the front door of the hotel is the LUAS tram service. This has been extended so, in about two minutes, you can be at Trinity College and the Book of Kells.

facts.text: Signature guestrooms have a newly designed 1930s liner-inspired Art Deco aesthetic with bespoke furnishings.
facts.excerpt: Newly designed with a sophisticated 1930s liner-inspired aesthetic, our Signature guestrooms are beautifully appointed with bespoke furnishings and sleek, streamlined details

facts.text: Garden guestrooms each overlook the hotel's quiet courtyard.
facts.excerpt: Each room overlooks our quiet courtyard, ensuring a restful stay away from the city's buzz.

facts.text: Deluxe guestrooms come courtyard-facing or with a private viewing terrace overlooking St. Stephen's Green.
facts.excerpt: Whether you choose a tranquil courtyard-facing retreat or a room with a private viewing terrace overlooking St. Stephen’s Green, this is five-star elegance at its finest.

facts.text: Deluxe guestrooms have a wool mohair sofa and a free-standing bath.
facts.excerpt: Step inside and sink into the plush wool mohair sofa, unwind in the free-standing bath

facts.text: Deluxe Premium guestrooms offer a choice of a combined bath and shower or a separate Chartreuse bath with a stand-alone shower.
facts.excerpt: Choice of a combined bath and shower or a separate Chartreuse bath with a stand-alone shower

facts.text: Diptyque toiletries are exclusive to the Deluxe Premium guestrooms.
facts.excerpt: Exclusive to our Deluxe Premium guestrooms - **DIPTYQUE** toiletries for an indulgent bathing experience

facts.text: When guests book a Deluxe Premium guestroom, the hotel matches them with a room suited to their preferences, such as a private terrace overlooking St. Stephen's Green, a four-poster bed or a freestanding bath.
facts.excerpt: Whether it’s a private terrace overlooking St. Stephen’s Green, a grand four-poster bed, or an opulent freestanding bath, every detail is designed for ultimate comfort.

facts.text: The Penthouse spans nearly 2,000 square feet at the top of the hotel.
facts.excerpt: Spanning nearly 2,000 square feet, this exquisite space is a masterpiece of contemporary design, perched atop the city’s best-located hotel.

facts.text: The Penthouse has a private butler available 24/7 who can arrange city tours, reservations or an in-room massage.
facts.excerpt: A private butler, available 24/7, will take care of everything—whether it’s arranging a private city tour, securing reservations at Dublin’s finest venues, or organizing an in-room massage.

facts.text: The Penthouse has a baby grand piano.
facts.excerpt: Baby grand piano for an elegant touch

facts.text: The Penthouse has rich-fired acacia wood flooring, deep shag pile rugs, a sculpted ceiling and handpicked Italian furnishings.
facts.excerpt: from the rich-fired acacia wood flooring and deep shag pile rugs to the sculpted, tactile ceiling and handpicked Italian furnishings

facts.text: The hotel is home to Glovers Alley, a Michelin-starred restaurant.
facts.excerpt: Michelin-starred dining at Glovers Alley

facts.text: Glovers Alley has a pink 1920s dining room and a French-inspired menu.
facts.excerpt: It’s also home to Glovers Alley, a new restaurant with a pink 1920s dining room and a French-inspired menu.

facts.text: Before a stay, someone from the hotel calls guests to ask what they want from their room.
facts.excerpt: Before your stay, someone will call to ask about what you want from your room and how he or she can help make your trip the best it can be.

facts.text: The hotel draws couples but no large groups, a deliberate decision to keep a boutique feel.
facts.excerpt: the hotel draws couples but, crucially, no large groups—a deliberate decision that helps maintain the boutique vibe.

facts.text: The hotel has a secure underground car park accessed from Mercer Street Lower.
facts.excerpt: it’s also got a secure underground car park. Access is from the back of the hotel on Mercer Street Lower

facts.text: Valet parking is currently not available.
facts.excerpt: currently valet parking is not available due to restrictions

facts.text: Valet parking is complimentary.
facts.excerpt: Valet parking is provided on a complimentary basis however, an overnight charge of €20.00 is applicable.

facts.text: The hotel can arrange a private car and driver transfer from Dublin Airport.
facts.excerpt: We can arrange a transfer from Dublin Airport to The Fitzwilliam Hotel by private car and driver.

facts.text: The hotel calls itself Dublin's newest refurbished five-star hotel.
facts.excerpt: Dublin's Newest Refurbished Five-Star Hotel

facts.text: The hotel's lobby is airy and scented with lemongrass, with a bar tucked away at the back.
facts.excerpt: from the airy lobby scented with lemongrass to the sexy bar tucked away at the back

facts.text: Superior guestrooms offer a Queen bed with views of St. Stephen's Green or a King bed overlooking the courtyard garden.
facts.excerpt: will it be a Queen bed with breathtaking views of St. Stephen’s Green or a King bed overlooking our… Read More
